definitions.explanation: A banknote that is brand new and unwrinkled. Crisp new bills are customarily used as gift money for celebratory occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新札|しんさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I exchanged my money for new bills at the bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→ご祝儀：08356_goshuugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新札|しんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧だ。
examples.english: It is good manners to prepare crisp new bills for gift money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新札|しんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえておいた。
examples.english: Since I was invited to a wedding, I got crisp new bills ready at the bank by the day before.

notes:
A brand-new, unwrinkled banknote. There is a strong custom of giving crisp new bills as celebratory gift money for weddings and other happy occasions; offering old, wrinkled bills is considered impolite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新札|しんさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{両替|りょうがえ}→両替：03680_ryougae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exchange for new bills
- {新札|しんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare crisp bills
- ピン{札|さつ}: crisp new bill (colloquial synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旧札|きゅうさつ}: old-design banknote — a bill of a discontinued design
- ⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧: banknote; bill — the general word for paper money
